output.text: INT. DINGY MOTEL - NIGHT1 1

A motel room so rundown and dirty the cockroaches don't stay. SHANNON CLARK (29) lies sick in bed, coughing. She weakly reaches for a glass of water sitting on a warped nightstand carved up with graffiti. Shannon strains to reach the water. Too weak. KAREN MURPHY (28), uptown glam and loathe to be in a place so dirty, pushes open the door and steps inside. Her fiance, RICKY TRAX (29), sporting a tailored suit that oozes "powerful businessman...wannabe" follows Karen like a nervous puppy. Karen reaches for the glass of water and "accidentally" knocks it over. Shannon collapses in exhaustion. KARENWhoops. Karen covers her mouth and giggles like a bitch. She links arms with Ricky, showing off her engagement ring, of which the dazzling shine pierces through Shannon's heart. KAREN(cont'd)Tomorrow, we are getting married. As my ex-best friend, I believe you want to give us your blessing, right? SHANNONBlessing? Fine. (coughs) Can I have some of my money back? My treatment isn't covered by... KARENShannon, how did you end up so shameless? Did you plan to feed off of Ricky your whole life? Ricky nervously adjusts his suit over and over. He doesn't like being here, but he's not about to say no to Karen. SHANNONRicky, before I trusted you with my fortune, you were the son of my father's chauffeur...who's feeding off who? Ricky scowls and shoves Karen out of the way. He reaches over and grabs Shannon by the throat, half-lifting her out of the bed. His grip tightens and tightens...

RICKYYou think I'm feeding off of YOU? Your father has been dead for years. Before you had me, you were a loser about to drop out of college. I earned my worth with blood and sweat tutoring dumb rich kids like you. You're nothing but the daughter of a filthy rich dead guy! ...until he flings her back to the bed. SHANNONYou said you would marry me, not her, if I gave you control of the business. I'm asking you for less than one-percent of what I gave you. Karen stifles laughter. Ricky rolls his eyes. Shannon collapses in a fit of tears and coughing.
INT. DINGY MOTEL - NIGHT2 2

Ricky leans to get into Shannon's face, to be intimidating, but when he sees how sick she is, he recoils in disgust. RICKYHow dare you even to bring that up? I saved the Clark family business from YOU, the useless, spoiled brat, who'd been carrying HIV, and never bothered to tell ME UNTIL THE NIGHT BEFORE OUR WEDDING!
RICKYHow many people did you sleep with? How many excuses do you still have? With a broken heart, Shannon is no longer listening. SHANNONRicky, did you ever love me?
output.speaker: SHANNONI DIDN'T KNOW!

output.text: A beat. Ricky is stunned by the audacity of her question. Ricky and Karen burst out laughing. Shannon is devastated. RICKYLove? What an insult. Being stuck with a woman so stupid, disgusting and phony, looking back, everyday was like a nightmare. How can I love someone who only makes me sick?

Shannon grips her chest, coughing. Wet, nasty coughs. Disgusted, Ricky walks out, leaving Karen to deliver the final blow. KARENAw, look at you, here at the end and the only thing you want to know is if Ricky loved you. You should be asking how a drug-free virgin like you ended up with AIDS. SHANNONYou know...? KARENSince you're about to die. I'll have some mercy and tell you a little secret. Someone was hired to inject you with HIV. I'm surprised you never figured that out, or jumped off a building, to save the world from your disgrace. SHANNONWho would do that...why? KARENRicky. The love of your life didn't want to marry you. Twenty dollars to a junkie, he's free and you're the dirty slut. Nice and easy. Horrified, Shannon pushes herself off the bed as Karen leaves, trying to stop her. SHANNONNo, that can't be true. No... Shannon gurgles and chokes, coughs spraying blood.
INT. DINGY MOTEL - NIGHT5 5

Johnny rushes to Shannon's side and pulls her close. She coughs blood all over his suit. JOHNNYYou need a doctor. Let me call 911... SHANNONJohnny Wonder...is it really you? She looks longingly into his eyes, stops him from calling. SHANNON(cont'd)It's too late. JOHNNYI'm so sorry, Shannon. I always thought you were doing well...happily married. If I had any idea it was like this...I would have stopped the wedding! I'd have taken you from Ricky Trax! Let me call an ambulance, please? Shannon smiles, almost laughing out of joy. Johnny is confused. Why is she laughing while dying? SHANNONI've never imagined, other than my father, there can be another man who cares so much about me. What a shame I wasted this life on a heartless monster. I'm a fool. Shannon, coughing more blood, has her eyes rolling back. She can barely keep her head upright. SHANNON(cont'd)In my next life, I will...choose differently... Shannon is breathing her last breath hearing: JOHNNYIn my next life, I will make you the happiest woman in the world. Tears falling down Johnny's face -- the last thing Shannon sees before she dies in his arms. Then, in an instant we are transported to...
INT. COLLEGE CLASSROOM - DAY6 6

A college classroom. Bright golden summer sunlight pours through a wall of windows. Desks are gleaming and every STUDENT in the room (including Shannon) wears casual clothes that cost thousands of dollars. Shannon is sleeping on her desk. JOHNNY (V.O.)(grieving as she dies)Shannon...Shannon...SHANNON! Shannon's eyes jolt open. She slowly lifts her head, unsure of where she is. Unsure why she's alive. Then she sees the name of her UNIVERSITY on a banner in the classroom. SHANNON (V.O.)This is...college? How can this be? I've been reborn ten years ago? Shannon (18) looks around and sees Ricky (19) and Karen (18) sitting next to each other one table away. Clearly a couple. RICKYWhat’s wrong, honey? KARENThe egg-salad gave me a tummy ache. Ricky looks at the lunch in front of Karen, then looks at Shannon who's still looking around the room in wonder. RICKY(to Karen)I'll be right back. Ricky walks over to Shannon. Shannon feels food coming from above: Ricky has dumped Karen's lunchbox on top of Shannon's head. Shannon is stunned. Frozen. Giggles everywhere. RICKY(cont'd)I told you to get some FOOD for Karen, not the garbage people like you eat. Go buy something edible. Shannon stares at Ricky, her face a cool, collected mask of rage. It unnerves Ricky to his core.
INT. CLASSROOM - DAY7 7

RICKY(whispering)Shannon what the hell are you doing? SHANNONYou still expect a free ride in my car after insulting me like that? Yancey and Sue watch from a distance, unable to hear what's being said, but willing to speculate anyway. YANCEYThat's Ricky's family car. Why does he let this bitch do that to him? SUEThat's what you get letting a maid's daughter ride with you. If you give a mouse a cookie... YANCEYC'mon Trax, just pull her out. RICKYDo you have to act like this? I forgive you about the lunch, but if you don't stop acting like this--
Shannon wipes egg-salad from her face.
SHANNONI don't need your forgiveness. You can walk home. Stop following me. RICKY (V.O.)I have to get in the car. Or I'll be exposed. If anyone knows I'm the son of their driver...

SHANNON (V.O.)Ricky Trax, in my previous life, I gave you everything, only for you to betray and murder me. This time will be different. RICKYAre you deaf? Go! Now! KARENRicky. Maybe I'd better go myself. Karen gives a pouty, simpering vibe that is pure condescension. Ricky raises his palm to stop Karen. RICKYWhy bother? Running errands for you makes her feel valued, right Shannon? SHANNON (V.O.)Yes. Let this meal start my revenge. Shannon stands up and walks out so purposefully Ricky smugly thinks his world is in order.

Ricky grabs Shannon's wrist and yanks her out of the car. Flinging her to the ground. He tosses her purse after her. The students laugh and cheer. Ricky helps Karen in the back seat then he gets in front the other side. Nobody moves to help Shannon. SHANNONRicky Trax, how dare you push me? RICKYDrive. The car zooms away. Shannon climbs to her feet, brushes off her purse and grabs her phone. YANCEYWell done Ricky, dealing with some ungrateful low life. That's what she deserved. SUERicky is so cool. Shannon is on the phone. SHANNONDad, our driver has forgotten who he works for. YANCEYCalling Ricky, begging for forgiveness? It's too late. SHANNONThe one who will beg for forgiveness is him. Watch. My car is coming back. Yancey laughs in disbelief. But her smile fades when the car engine roars as it reverses back to Shannon. Ricky, and Karen climb out. Mr. Trax is most chastised of all. Everyone who mocked Shannon are stunned. MR. TRAXShannon, please get in the car. I'll take you wherever you want to go. Shannon walks past Yancey and Sue proudly in vindication and gets into the backseat.
INT. DINING HALL - DAY8 8

The dining hall is impressive, like if The Cheesecake Factory wasn't tacky. While Shannon picking up food, Yancey (18), a classmate struts up beside her ready to cause trouble. YANCEYFetching lunch for your master again? With brilliant girls like Karen around, Ricky won't waste a glance on your kind. You know that right? Other STUDENTS watch the show, giggling behind their hands. SHANNONWhat kind am I? YANCEYThe "daughter of his maid" kind. The "follows him to school every day" kind. The "dream of marrying rich" kind. The "if your lucky you can make his bed, sweep his floors, scrub his toilet" kind. You know. Your kind. SHANNONThat's what Ricky told you? Did he tell you "his luxury car" belongs to MY family? That he's the son of MY driver?

The crowd watching gets bigger, laughs a little louder. It doesn't phase Shannon at all. YANCEYWhat a psycho! Barking like a chihuahua just because Ricky won't look at you? Hurry up, your master's lunch is getting cold. SHANNON (V.O.)The driver's son saying I'm HIS maid! Ricky Trax, you are going to pay for that. Shannon takes her food and walks through the crowd that was watching and laughing. They all turn away in embarrassment.
INT. CLASSROOM - DAY9 9

Shannon smiles with amusement. SHANNON (V.O.)Oh there is a line to cross? I had no idea. But, this is just the beginning. Ricky Trax, Karen.... She slams the door, almost crushing Ricky's hand, leaving him and Karen embarrassed. The window glides down -- SHANNONBye. (to Mr. Trax.) Driver, drive. The car peels out.

Shannon sits at her desk, finishing up the food she was supposed to bring to Ricky and Karen. Karen, Ricky and Yancey walk in, seeing the empty containers in front of Shannon. RICKYI told you to bring food for Karen and you ate it? Mine too? God, you're such a pig. Shannon tosses her fork and knife down, and crosses her arms. She's done with this dude. SHANNONI bought this with my money. Two meals or twenty meals what does it have to do with you? YANCEYYour money? Even if you spend it, it's still Trax money. Duh. SHANNONWhat do you think, Ricky Trax? Who's money is it? RICKYI think getting lunch when you're told to get lunch for your boss is a simple task. He leans over and whispers loudly in her ear.

RICKY(cont'd)If someone can't get that right, she's gotta be stupid. SHANNONWho's my boss? Her? If this capable young woman is too lazy to get her own lunch, she deserves a tummy ache. RICKYYou— YANCEYYou're a Trax family maid. Taking care of his girlfriend is your job. Why is that so hard to comprehend? Ignoring Yancey, Shannon rises to her feet and faces Ricky. SHANNONRicky Trax. Am I your maid? Ricky flinches. He's not used to direct confrontation like this. RICKYAlright, Shannon, alright. I'm not interested in this little game you're playing. Don't cause trouble because I won't forgive you. No matter how much you beg me. SHANNONBeg you? Why would I? What have I done wrong? A stand-off. Ricky scoffs and rolls his eyes. RICKYYou think you're tough? Fine, there's no seat for you in my car. You can walk home. Everyone walks out, and Shannon watches them go. SHANNON (V.O.)Your car? It was never yours and it's time you learned your place.
INT. CAR - DAY11 11

Hearing their words, Shannon rolls up the window. Trying to relaxes, she closes her eyes. SHANNONDrive. The driver, MR. TRAX (50) Ricky's father turns around to address Shannon. He's in a suit, but a cheap one. MR. TRAXLet’s wait for Ricky. SHANNONMr. Trax, you work for my father and me. I decide who we wait for. MR. TRAXDid you have a fight with him or something? I'll have a word with Ricky, for sure. But try to be nicer to him, if you please. I know you look down on us, but... SHANNONDrive! I don’t want him in my car. I don't want him in my house. I don’t want to see him anymore! MR. TRAXWell, let’s wait. SHANNONAre you going to drive or not? MR. TRAX (V.O.)She's usually so scared of Ricky. What's going on today?

Did she forget I'm her future father in law, or the fact my son will take over her father's business? SHANNONMr. Trax I asked-- MR. TRAXLook, they’re coming out. Shannon, fuming, sees Ricky and Karen walking out of the building toward the car. Mr. Trax hops out, deferential as hell, opening the door to the backseat for his son. But when Ricky opens the door, Shannon grabs it and refuses to let Ricky inside. Panic flashes across Ricky's face.
EXT. SCHOOL - DAY13 13

Sue and Yancey watch the drama between Shannon, Ricky, and Mr. Trax play out in the parking lot. SUEEven Ricky's driver gets so respectful to a maid's daughter. This doesn't make sense. YANCEYWhy did Ricky get out? Mr. Trax clings to Shannon's door like it's a shield and timidly speaks over the top edge. MR. TRAXShannon, was it really necessary to bother your father? For your little argument with Ricky? He's very busy. SHANNONFrom now on, they two are not allowed in this car. MR. TRAXIsn't that a little--childish, Shannon? SHANNONYou are not close enough to use my name. Remember who pays you. I think to drive when your boss tells you to drive is a simple task. If you can't get that right, feel free to quit. MR. TRAXI...I know I was wrong. I'll drive right now. Before his father closes the door, Ricky stops him. RICKYShannon, that's enough. SHANNONOh look, the "young master" is mad. KARENShannon, you may not like me, but there's no need to bully Ricky. He's always nice to you. He had the driver come back just for you. Why do you have to be so mean? RICKYNo need to tell her that. She doesn't know anything about gratitude.
Shannon, you've really crossed the line this time. Shannon rolls her eyes.
INT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - KITCHEN - NIGHT15 15

Shannon walks into the huge, open concept kitchen filled with natural light and spectacular views of the city. She finds an older woman, AUNT JO, preparing dinner. Jo takes her handbag. AUNT JOMiss, you're back alone? Where’s your friend Ricky? SHANNONAunt Jo, from now on, I don't have any friends named Ricky. AUNT JOMiss, you’ve finally come to your senses. With instant regret crossing the boundary, Aunt Jo covers her mouth awkwardly. Shannon reaches out and holds her hand. SHANNON (V.O.)Aunt jo was the kindest of all the servants in the house. In my past life, she always warned me about Ricky, but I was so blind in love that I pushed her away. In this life, I won’t fail her again.

AUNT JOSorry miss, I spoke out of turn... SHANNONIt’s okay, Aunt jo. You were right. I'm going to go lay down for a bit. It's been a long day. AUNT JOAlright. Oh, Johnny Wonder came to visit. I can send him away though, if you're tired... About to leave the room, hearing that, Shannon's face lights up in excitement. SHANNONJohnny? Where is he? Aunt Jo points and Shannon runs that direction.
EXT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - TERRACE - NIGHT16 16
INT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT23

Shannon steps out of the house and sees, standing in a pool of light, the most handsome young man in the world, JOHNNY WONDER. This is the first time she's seen him since being reborn. He hears her gasp and turns. The entire world slows down as this beautiful person turns to rest his eyes on Shannon. SHANNON (V.O.)This is 20 year old Johnny, the fiancé my father arranged for me. In my past life, because of Ricky Trax, I was not fond of him. He wanted to be with me, but I wanted only Ricky. I not only refused him but also said hurtful things to him. She holds back tears. Johnny isn't sure what's up but he only cares for her. SHANNONJohnny, it's so nice to see you again. JOHNNYMiss Clark, it’s nice to see you too. SHANNONJohnny, is there something you needed?

At a elegant glass desk, Johnny and Shannon sit next to each other. Johnny diligently works through a complicated math problem, explaining the steps, but Shannon stares at him dreamily, absorbed in her own thoughts. SHANNON (V.O.)God, Johnny is nothing like Ricky. Johnny has patience, he speaks well, he never complains. And OH MY GOODNESS is he handsome. (beat) How could I have been so blind in my previous life?

JOHNNYI wanted to see you. Hesitating, in awkward silence. JOHNNY(cont'd)I know you don’t want to see me, so I’ll go. Johnny turns away, ready to leave, when Shannon stops him. SHANNONJohnny... She almost grabs his hand to stop him from going. SHANNON(cont'd)Would you like to have dinner with me? JOHNNYReally? The romantic tension between them is insane. We half-expect them to start making out right then and there. SHANNONSure. Aunt Jo is the best chef! As she leads Johnny inside she can't help looking over her shoulder and smiling at him.

How could I waste all my time on someone like Ricky Trax. Especially when Johnny was right there all along! She doesn't realize Johnny is watching her think. JOHNNYIs there something you don’t understand? She doesn't say anything, just keeps looking at him. Then she realizes he said something and snaps out of it. SHANNONSorry, I’m just too dumb. JOHNNYShannon, you're not dumb. You're just using the wrong study method. Let me help you build a stronger foundation first, then if your grades don't improve...you can fire me and I'll return everything you've paid me already. SHANNONAre you sure? You really mean that? Johnny nods. Then they smile at each other. Ricky stomps into the room. He doesn't even acknowledge Johnny and rips into Shannon. RICKYShannon, seriously, what’s your deal? She speaks slowly and clearly, like she's dealing with a child. SHANNONWhat do you want now? RICKYYou threw my things in the basement! Johnny carefully watches the back and forth. SHANNONI told you this afternoon, you've been fired. I have a new tutor. So why should you stay at my house? Especially in such a nice room? ESPECIALLY after I fired your father too! But if you insist on staying, the basement is all yours. Ricky slams his palms on the desk. Shannon doesn't flinch.

RICKYShannon, do you think it's fun to humiliate me? SHANNONHumiliate you? Stop being so dramatic. RICKYFine, Shannon, don’t think I don’t know what you’re up to. RICKY (V.O.)Tomorrow at the birthday party, I’ll make sure you regret this. I’ll make you kneel in front of everyone and apologize. Shannon slaps the papers with each word, trying to break through Ricky's dense idiocy. SHANNONWe’re still in class. Can you stop interrupting us? Ricky is thrown off his game. He's still not used to Shannon resisting him. RICKYFine. Just wait. Ricky points a finger at Shannon. Johnny shifts his weight, ready to leap in and defend Shannon if necessary. Ricky and Shannon both notice.
INT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - KITCHEN - NIGHT17 17
INT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - FRONT DOOR - NIGHT24

Aunt Jo bustles in the kitchen while Shannon and Johnny sit shyly near each other trying to steal looks at the other but not get caught doing it. SHANNONAunt jo, let’s start dinner. AUNT JOWe're not waiting for Ricky? Hearing "Ricky", Johnny's eyes dart to Shannon, watching to see what she'll say. SHANNONWhy? AUNT JO (V.O.)Thank goodness, Miss Shannon won't be such a suck-up anymore.

As Ricky passes through the kitchen, he pauses and holds up three fingers. RICKYShe'll be here in three, two, one... He turns around, grinning smugly. She's not there. RICKY(cont'd)What the heck? Why is Shannon suddenly acting so tough? She knows she's making me angry. I swear she is going to learn a hard lesson.

AUNT JOI’ll get everything ready right away. SHANNONJohnny, you're grades are really good, aren't they? Mine are terrible. Would you mind...being my tutor? You could come here every day and help me study. JOHNNYI thought Ricky Trax was your tutor? JOHNNY (V.O.)And you love him so much you pushed me far away from you. SHANNONHe’s about to be fired. Johnny barely suppresses a smile. JOHNNYIf you would like, I'm available. Maybe we could begin tomorrow? SHANNONYes. Tomorrow, then. Johnny leaves. Moments later Ricky storms in, angry. RICKYShannon, why'd you tear my dad a new one in front of everyone? What's wrong with you? Go apologize to him right now or I'll-- SHANNONI disciplined my driver. I pay his salary and he leaves me on the side of the road! And you think I should apologize? RICKYHe's my dad! Anything he did was because I told him to do it!That’s my dad! It had nothing to do with him. If you have an issue, deal with me! SHANNONOh, right. Your father answers to you. In that case, you can both pack your bags and go. RICKYWhat? What did you just say?
He feels a thrill of fear. He knows he's playing with fire and in danger of getting burned. Shannon is ready to set him on fire.
INT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - KITCHEN - NIGHT18 18

Shannon slams her hand on the table. Rattling dishes. Her hand landing near the handle of a very sharp knife. SHANNONI don't want you here anymore! Ever since you started tutoring me, my grades have only gotten worse. Why am I paying you anything at all! RICKYIt's not my fault your stupid! I explain the same thing to Karen, one time, the same way and she gets it. Why can't you? Because you're as dumb as a rock. Switch tutors, see if I care, but don't come crawling back when you fail even faster. SHANNONFine! I will, but you and your good for nothing Dad can't live here anymore. I want you both out! Ricky tries a different approach, full-condescension. RICKYOK, OK, it's you're not dumb, Shannon. You're obsessed with dating me so you can't focus. That's why your grades are so bad. SHANNONWhat are you talking about? RICKYYou’re causing all this fuss because you’re jealous of my relationship with Karen, right? SHANNONYou think I want to be with you? RICKYOh my god, it's OBVIOUS! SHANNONRicky Trax, being with you is the last thing I want in this life!
RICKYSay whatever you want. But I am warning you—if you disrespect me like that in public again...whatever I do next is your fault.
INT. CAR - DAY19 19

After school, Shannon gets in the car and shuts the door. After a moment of confusion she looks at the driver. SHANNONLet’s go. Ricky walks over with Karen next to him. RICKYDad’s let's drop off Karen first. MR. TRAXAlright, my boy. SHANNONDriver, did you even ask for my opinion? From now on, there will be no unnecessary people in my car. Including him. Ricky shoves his way into the car, but Shannon refuses to make enough room for Karen, who stands there watching. MR. TRAXMiss Shannon, you have a good relationship with Ricky, right? Don't let something small hurt your feelings for him. SHANNONMister Trax, I don’t think suited to driving. Someone who loves doling out advice should be a therapist. Was that your dream? Could you not cut it in med school? Is that why you're a driver? RICKYShannon! That's enough! How can y ou talk to my fa--your driver like that? SHANNONHow dare YOU speak to YOUR employer this way? She literally kicks him out of the car.

SHANNON(cont'd)You think you’re worthy to sit with me? (to Mr. Trax) DRIVE! He drives. Leaving his own son on the side of the road. RICKYShannon, you've really pissed me off this time! I'll see you on your knees begging for my forgiveness! KARENRicky, what’s going on with you? She's the daughter of your driver. Why are you letting her push you around like this? KAREN (V.O.)Everyone says she's the rich one and you're the fake...maybe they're right?
INT. CLASSROOM - DAY20 20

The next morning at school. Shannon is at her desk reading when Ricky comes up and leans over her. RICKYShannon, I heard you were talking to Johnny Wonder. SHANNONWhat's it to you? RICKYBringing him around, trying to make me jealous isn't going to make me forgive you, if that's what you think. SHANNONWhy would I think that? I don't even like thinking about you. RICKYYou know, I can’t stand women who can’t make up their minds. Am I making myself clear? She glares up at him, narrowing her eyes. SHANNONOh, I've made up my mind about you.
INT. CLASSROOM - DAY21 21

Shannon stands up, forcing Ricky to take a step back so she doesn't bash him with her head. SHANNONI can't believe I tolerated you for so long. You treat me this way and then spend MY money on...KAREN? Ricky punches the table, trying to restrain his anger. RICKYYour money? I earned that money trying to fix your dumb brain! Compensation for heavy labor! SHANNONMaybe if I demand a refund my grades will go back up! RICKYI already told you it's not my fault! It's your mind that's the problem! SHANNONRicky, you’re fired! RICKYYou think someone else-- SHANNONI already hired a new tutor. Ricky moves closer, keeping his voice lower, not sure if Shannon is playing the part he wants her to play. RICKYShannon, if you're playing hard to get or something you need to cut it out. If you keep this up, I really won’t be your tutor anymore and where do you think that leaves you? SHANNONOh my god, and you call me dumb. Ricky, you are fiieee-rrrrrr-DUH! Shannon walks out of the room. RICKYYou-- Ricky is about to follow Shannon but Karen blocks his path. KARENRicky, what's really going on with you and Shannon?

RICKYWho knows? Don’t gives a shit. KARENRight. OK. Anyway, tomorrow is your birthday. Are we still celbrating at your family's hotel? Are you going to help me rent a dress? Ricky? Ricky! RICKYWhat? No. Why would you rent a dress? I'll buy you one. Karen smiles slyly to herself. Free dress coming her way. Ricky looks away, distracted by something he just realized. RICKY (V.O.)THAT'S what's going on. Shannon always plans my birthday celebrations. She's just acting dramatic to heighten the surprise. Ha, nice try Shannon but I told you you were going to far. You'll find my forgiveness costs more than a birthday party. Ricky smiles to himself.
INT. CLASSROOM - DAY22 22

Ricky looks at Karen, smiling to himself. She doesn't understand why he's looking so smug. KARENRicky, why aren’t you saying anything? Instead of answering, Ricky wraps his arm around Karen's waist and turns so they both face the rest of the class. Everyone listens intently. RICKYListen up everyone, tomorrow night at the Royal Court Hotel, it’s my 20th birthday. There will be food, music, drink...a night to remember! The class can't contain their excitement. SUEOh my god! The Royal Court Hotel? That's like...higher than five stars! I can't believe he's celebrating there!

YANCEYOf course he is, the Trax family OWNS the Royal Court. The staff literally BOW to Ricky. Ricky and Karen watch Sue and Yancey praise them with a mixture of smugness and embarrassment. SUEHoly shit! Yancey, you HAVE to get me a ticket! RICKYWhat are you talking about, Sue? A ticket? I personally invited you! Every single one of you is personally invited! While the crowd cheers...Karen speaks to Ricky. KARENRicky, do you think Shannon will come? Should we invite her? RICKYHer? Even if I don’t send her an invitation, she’ll come running. RICKY (V.O.)Shannon, you think you're so clever. You think this party will save you? Nope, you're in a for rude awakening. NOBODY disrespects me. KARENYeah, she can't stay away from you. I'll have to teach her a lesson. Karen looks up lovingly at Ricky, with the faintest of smirks on her face.
INT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - STUDY - NIGHT25 25

Shannon stamps her foot in frustration. Behind her, Johnny is packing up his papers, folders, and pencils. SHANNONI'm sorry you had to see that, Johnny. She sits down next to Johnny. JOHNNYMaybe I should just go. You don’t seem to be in a good mood. SHANNONNo, I’m fine. Really, I’m in a good mood. JOHNNYThat’s good to hear. Shannon puts her hands on Johnny's arm to keep him from leaving. Both a little embarrassed by the intimacy. SHANNONBy the way, are you free tomorrow night? I want to go to the Royal Court Hotel for dinner. Do you want to join me? It’s been so many years since I last ate there. I miss the food. Johnny's mood darkens, saddens. JOHNNYYears? Didn’t you just go there with Ricky last week? You...seem to take him there a lot. SHANNONHow do you know that? JOHNNYBecause the Royal Court Hotel is-- He looks her in the eye and hesitates. He was about to say "my family's hotel." JOHNNY(cont'd)I was there, too, and I saw you. She becomes playful and teasing to pull him out of the mood. GEORGEOnly when Vincent sees with his own eyes how deeply in love you two are will he truly give up. That’s why you must live together. Sebastian frowns, conflicted. SEBASTIANBut Lydia will be upset. GEORGE(chuckling softly)Why don’t you ask Lydia yourself? I don’t think she’s as fragile as you imagine.

Her arms rest on the glass railing as she lets the night breeze wash over her. Sebastian approaches quietly, draping a blanket over her shoulders. He wraps his arms around her from behind, resting his chin against her hair. Lydia tilts her head, smiling. SEBASTIAN(gentle)Is living with Vincent and Zoe making you unhappy?Do you want me to kick them out? LYDIA(calm, resolute)If they take one step forward and we retreat, they’ll only push harder. Whoever moves out first loses. I don’t intend to lose. Sebastian kisses the top of her head. SEBASTIANI know. You’ll win. He lowers his head, kissing her neck. Lydia laughs softly, ticklish. LYDIAStop… On the adjacent balcony, Vincent steps out impatiently, pulling out a cigarette. He looks up and sees Sebastian holding Lydia from behind, kissing her bare shoulder and neck. Vincent’s expression twists. He clenches the cigarette, snaps it in half. The crushed tobacco falls from his fingers.
EXT. VILLA BEDROOM BALCONY – NIGHT
INT. VILLA HALLWAY – NIGHT
Sebastian stands behind Lydia, kissing along her cheek, her neck, her shoulder. Lydia’s shoulders lift slightly as she closes her eyes, breathing unevenly.
Vincent charges down the corridor. He stops abruptly in front of a closed bedroom door. His hand reaches out, then grips the doorknob tightly. His chest heaves.

Sebastian gently hooks two fingers under her chin, turning her face toward him. SEBASTIAN(low, teasing)Do you still have the strength…for another round? Lydia inhales sharply. LYDIA(Softly)No— Before she can finish, Sebastian captures her lips. He turns her body toward him, the kiss deepening. Lydia’s hands slide up around his neck, responding instinctively. SEBASTIAN(murmuring against her lips)Your body disagrees with your mouth. He lifts her slightly, holding her close. Sebastian reaches into his pocket— Lydia catches his wrist. Their lips part, foreheads touching, breath tangled. LYDIA(quiet, resolute)We don’t need that anymore. I want a child. A child that belongs to us. Sebastian freezes. Pure, unguarded joy flashes through his eyes. He lets go of the item in his hand without a second thought. It arcs through the air, landing on the adjacent balcony. Vincent stands there, frozen. His bloodshot eyes drop to the ground. Then slowly lift, locking onto Sebastian and Lydia. VINCENT(breathless, breaking)No… Sebastian adjusts Lydia in his arms, kisses her deeply, laughing softly as he turns and carries her back inside.
VINCENT (CONT'D)(roaring)STOP! Sebastian doesn’t look back. The balcony doors close. Vincent slams his fist against the railing, shaking with rage. He spins, storms back inside.
INT. VILLA HALLWAY – NIGHT

Vincent’s hand is locked on the doorknob. Before he can turn it, a cane strikes down sharply, pinning his wrist. George steps forward, eyes cold. GEORGE(low, commanding)Go back to your room. Take care of your wife and your child. Stop disturbing your brother and his wife. Vincent jerks his hand back, fury blazing. VINCENT(gritted teeth)His wife?! Fine. Then I’ll let the reporters decide. I’ll tell the world exactly whose wife Lydia really is. He yanks out his phone, about to dial, George snatches it from his hand and slams it onto the marble floor. The screen shatters. George lifts his cane, pointing it straight at Vincent. GEORGE(final warning)This is the last time I warn you.(MORE)

GEORGE (CONT'D)If this scandal reaches the public and damages our family’s reputation—every share of the company under your name will be taken back. All of it. Vincent freezes. The threat lands. VINCENT(shaken, unwilling)…On what grounds? Sebastian stole my wife. He owes me. GEORGE(cold, absolute)No one owes you anything. This situation is the result of your own choices. And the consequence you must bear is letting Lydia go. Zoe rushes in, wrapping her arms around Vincent, forcing a smile toward George. ZOE(overly cheerful)Don’t worry, sir. I’ll keep an eye on him. I won’t let him act recklessly. George gives her a frosty glance, then turns and walks away. Silence falls. Zoe tightens her grip on Vincent, lowering her voice. ZOE (CONT'D)(reasoning, coaxing)Vincent, think about the money. And think about the baby. Throwing away everything you have for Lydia, it’s not worth it. Vincent stares at Sebastian’s closed bedroom door. His eyes burn red. He suddenly slams his fist into the wall, a dull thud echoes down the hallway. Zoe flinches. VINCENT (hoarse, breaking)Lydia… Am I really supposed to just stand by and watch you be taken from me?
His jaw tightens, eyes filling with rage and despair. VINCENT (CONT'D)(low, venomous)I won’t accept this. I won’t.
INT. VILLA RECREATION ROOM – DAY

Sebastian leans over at the pool table, hits in a ball, his shirt unbuttoned down to his abs. Lydia leans against the wall behind him, wearing a bikini, checking out the shape of Sebastian. She bites her lip. LYDIAI didn’t know you were also a master pool player. Sebastian turns around, checking Lydia out. He yanks Lydia into his arms. Lydia puts her hands on Sebastian's chest. Sebastian holds the cue with one hand while the other hand traces up between Lydia's legs. SEBASTIANWant to learn? Say the word. Sebastian pins Lydia under him on the pool table. Lydia looks up at Sebastian, doe-eyed, her throat bobs as Sebastian's lips are inches away from her. LYDIATeach me... Before she finishes, Sebastian flips and pins her down again, pressing her face-down at the pool table with one hand. Vincent and Zoe enters and sees them. Vincent's eyes turn red, his hand holding a wine glass trembles. SEBASTIAN(whispering)Don’t tense your wrist.Billiards doesn’t respond well to force. LYDIA(low, teasing)Then what does it respond to? A faint smile curves Sebastian’s lips.

SEBASTIANGuidance. He leans closer. His chest brushes lightly against her back. His breath lingers just behind her ear. LYDIA(soft, absorbed)And then? SEBASTIANNow! Lydia strikes. The cue ball rolls smoothly, hits the red ball cleanly. Straight into the pocket. Lydia breaks into a smile, turning her head toward him. LYDIAI did it! The wine glass in Vincent's hand shatters from his tight grip.
INT. VILLA RECREATION ROOM – DAY
EXT. VILLA POOL – DAY
VINCENTSebastian, I'm not giving Lydia to you. You will get what's coming for you. Vincent leaves in fury. ZOE(Jealous)Lydia, I'm tired with the world with you in it.

Lydia lounges on a sun chair by the pool. Bikini. Sunglasses. Relaxed. Radiant. Zoe storms over and deliberately blocks the sunlight. Lydia frowns and opens her eyes. ZOEEnjoying two men fighting over you? Feeling proud of yourself?

Chasing after married men, that’s low, even for you. Lydia sits up. Slowly removes her sunglasses. Stands. She looks Zoe straight in the eye, calm but cutting. LYDIAI’ll give that speech right back to you, Zoe. You earned every consequence coming your way. She steps past Zoe, brushing her shoulder as she moves to leave. Zoe snaps. She grabs Lydia’s arm. ZOEYou don’t walk away from me, say it clearly! They struggle. Hands push. Feet slip. Suddenly, Zoe shoves hard. Lydia loses her balance, falls into the pool with a splash. Zoe staggers backward, slips, and tumbles in after her. At that exact moment, Sebastian and Vincent rush out from opposite sides. Both freeze for half a second, then shout at the same time. SEBASTIAN / VINCENTLydia! They leap into the pool, one after the other. Water explodes upward.
EXT. VILLA POOL – DAY
INT. HOSPITAL ROOM – DAY
INT. HOSPITAL HALLWAY – DAY

Sebastian and Vincent plunge through the water toward Lydia. Sebastian reaches her first. He wraps his arms around her and pulls her to the surface, hauling her onto the pool deck. Vincent climbs out right behind him. Sebastian immediately begins CPR, pressing down and giving rescue breaths. Vincent stands frozen nearby, fists clenched. His face twists with worry—and jealousy he forces himself to swallow. Zoe struggles in the water, ignored by Vincent. ZOE(screaming)Vincent! Help me! Please, help me!

Sebastian sits at Lydia’s bedside, gripping her hand tightly. Vincent stands a few steps away, anxious, eyes never leaving her face. Lydia’s lashes flutter. She slowly opens her eyes. Both men exhale at the same time. SEBASTIAN(relieved, emotional)Lydia… You’re awake. You scared me to death.

After a while, Zoe is dragged in by two men in black suits. She thrashes, shaking her head wildly. ZOENo! It wasn’t me! She’s framing me! Sebastian steps forward calmly. He pulls out his phone, taps the screen, security footage plays. Clear. Unmistakable. Sebastian stops in front of Zoe. He slaps. Zoe freezes. INT. HOSPITAL ROOM – DAY

George stands tall, eyes sharp. He signals the butler, who steps forward holding a neatly folded lab report. Vincent freezes, shock washing over his face. Zoe’s eyes dart nervously. Vincent grabs her by the throat, trembling with rage. VINCENT(furious)You've been lying to me?! He slaps her hard. Zoe collapses to her knees, clutching her face. Vincent points at her, furious. Vincent is left in shock. Lydia laughs coldly, venom in every word. LYDIALove? Seven years of marriage, all my sacrifices… and you? INT. HOSPITAL ROOM – DAY

He glances back at Lydia one last time, eyes filled with regret. Then he walks away, utterly defeated. Lydia exhales slowly, turns to face Sebastian, who watches her anxiously. They lock eyes. LYDIA(tired, soft)Sebastian… The game is over. We both need to return to our rightful places. Sebastian grabs her shoulders, lowering his head to meet her eyes. SEBASTIAN(earnest)I never treated this time with you like a game.
INT. HOSPITAL ROOM – DAY

LYDIA(dismissive, guarded)Stop joking. I know you played along for thrills, helping your brother… Sebastian takes her hand, placing it over his chest. SEBASTIAN(heartfelt)Lydia… I love you. I’ve always loved you. From the first time I saw you on the course at ten… my heart has belonged only to you. Lydia freezes. Sebastian reaches into his suit, removing a tie clip, and hands it to her.

SEBASTIAN (CONT'D)When you won your first championship, I was just a fan shaking your hand… and you dropped this hairpin. I picked it up… and I’ve never let it go. Lydia’s eyes widen with realization. LYDIA(soft, astonished)It was you… You liked me all along? I always thought you hated me… Sebastian steps closer, his expression tender and unwavering. SEBASTIANI’ve always liked you. When I learned my brother was going to marry you, it hurt me… I tried to let go, but I couldn’t. I thought hope was gone… then your… “memory loss” gave me a chance. Lydia’s eyes glisten, emotions breaking through. SEBASTIAN (CONT'D)I know you’ve been hurt… it’s hard to trust love again. But I’ll show you with my actions… please, give me a chance. Let me prove my love. Lydia looks down at the hairpin, a small smile touching her lips. She clenches it gently in her hand, then lifts her gaze to him. LYDIAI thought I’d never believe in love again… but you’ve made my heart beat anew. I'll give it another shot, with you... Sebastian’s tense expression melts into pure joy. He pulls Lydia into a tight embrace. SEBASTIAN(grateful, relieved)Thank you, Lydia. I promise… I won't let you down. I will make you the happiest woman in this world. Lydia hugs him back, smiling, content. The camera pulls back, capturing the couple in a perfect, tender frame of reunited love.

output.text: You piece of shit! I'll kill you!
output.speaker: ANDREW

output.text: Let go of him! You nut case!
output.speaker: HEIDI

output.text: You're dead meat now!
output.speaker: DORIS

output.text: No, no, Andrew, please forgive Riley. Don't hurt him. He doesn't mean any disrespect. Riley, let him go. Riley glances at Caroline, then lets go of Andrew.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: That's it. I'm calling my security right now. They'll teach you a lesson!
output.speaker: ANDREW

output.text: No!
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Enough! We're here to spend Christmas together. Let's eat. Anyone not interested can leave.
output.speaker: DRAVEN

output.text: Everyone quiets down, though Andrew, Doris, and the others still look upset.

Grandpa's right. Why don't we all calm down. It was just a misunderstanding. Let's go. Andrew and the others, still fuming, follow Draven to the dining room. Caroline sighs in relief and takes Riley's hand.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Come on, Riley, you need to stop saying crazy things like that. You know how much I worry about you!
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Don't worry, darling. I'll be fine.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Just be careful, Riley. Riley smiles, nodding, and they head to the dining room together.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: EXT. BAKER HOUSE – DAY
Doris, long time no see. Merry Christmas! Doris takes out the divorce papers.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Enough chit-chat. Here are the divorce papers. Sign them. Caroline, annoyed, takes the papers.
output.speaker: DORIS

output.text: Mom, Riley came all the way here to spend Christmas with us. You really have to bring this up now?
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Spend Christmas with us? We don't need his company! We'd all be happier without him around.
output.speaker: DORIS

output.text: Doris!
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Enough, Doris! Stop being so mean to him! Don't worry, Riley, I'm not divorcing you. The only reason we asked Andrew here was so that he can help us take the gifts to the Draven's.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: You're so naive! You married a loser who can't even earn a dime! You have a wealthy and handsome suitor right here, yet you're still living with this loser!
output.speaker: DORIS

output.text: A suitor? Doris grabs Andrew over to her side, and looks at him with pride.
Andrew here is the R&D director at Ravenham Auto Plant, and his father is the deputy plant manager. If it weren't for you, Caroline would have married him and become a rich wife by now!
output.speaker: DORIS

output.text: Come on, Doris. I know you're right, but let's not be too hard on the poor guy. Andrew reaches to put his arm around Caroline's shoulder. Caroline flinches and quickly pulls away. Andrew's expression darkens slightly. Riley gives Andrew a cold stare.
output.speaker: ANDREW

output.text: What's wrong, boy? Got a problem with me?
output.speaker: ANDREW

output.text: I just want you to stay away from my wife. And as for " poor" , do you two know what you're talking about?
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: What else would you be? You're so broke you can't even afford a car! And now you're telling Andrew to keep his distance from Caroline?
output.speaker: DORIS

output.text: Mom! Please, just stop talking!
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Why should I? I'm only speaking the truth! Riley, look at Andrew's car. You'll never own something like that in your life! Riley looks at Andrew's car parked along the street.
output.speaker: DORIS

output.text: You're right. I'll never have a car like that. Andrew's face lights up with pride.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Oh, so you do know your place. I was thinking you might rent something ridiculous just to impress Caroline. Riley's eyes move from the car to the two of them.
output.speaker: DORIS

output.text: That Porsche is so cheap, it didn't even make it to the last year's international auto expo. So you're tight, I'll never buy one of those. Doris and Andrew are stunned.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: EXT. BAKER HOUSE – DAY
Ha! Riley, even your jokes are terrible! You really think you can buy one? Do you have that kind of money?
output.speaker: DORIS

output.text: An international auto expo? Do you even know what that is? That's where the real elites gather. You think you'd be invited?
Actually, yes. This was my first time attending the thing. They've been asking me to come for years, but I was always too busy.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Oh, they have been asking you for years, and you turned them down? Let me guess, did the governor also invite you to his party?
output.speaker: ANDREW

output.text: You mean Henry? I didn't hear about any party.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Unbelievable! He's such a clown!
output.speaker: DORIS

output.text: Riley, come on. Time to... stop with these fairy tales, don't you think?
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Caroline, there are things you don't know yet. I'll explain it all to you later.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Caroline, the chairman of the Wharton Group just arrived in Ravenham. I need to get back and help my dad prepare the welcome dinner. I don't have time to listen to this clown. I'll see you later at our Christmas lunch. Andrew gets into his car and drives off. Doris glares at Riley.
output.speaker: ANDREW

output.text: This is all your fault! Now Andrew's upset! Just let Caroline be with Andrew already!
output.speaker: DORIS

output.text: Mom, that's enough. Let's go inside. Cornell is still waiting for us. Doris storms angrily into the house. Caroline turns to Riley with a reassuring smile. CAROLINE Riley, mom's pretty hot-tempered. Please don't take it to heart. You know I'll always be on your side. Riley holds onto her hand gratefully.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Babe, you're the one who waited for me for three whole years. And I will be forever grateful. Just know that wherever you are, that's where I'll be. Riley kisses on her hand, then they embrace, quietly sharing a moment.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: I've missed you so much. I'm so glad you're back. Riley kisses Caroline. Her phone rings. Caroline gestures at the phone, and Riley smiles and gives her an "OK" hand gesture. CAROLINE Hello? Demi?
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Oh my God, Caroline! You'll never guess happened! I just saw the chairman of the Wharton Group—he's so young, rich, and sooo handsome!
output.speaker: DEMI

output.text: It was like...I fell in love at first sight!
Riley and Caroline stand outside the house. Riley smiles warmly at Caroline, who waves her phone at Riley.
My good friend, Demi, the shining star of the Ravenham Auto Plant, I'll introduce you next time. You go ahead inside, I'll catch up in a minute.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Alright. Caroline puts the phone back to her ear, and smiles.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Wow! He was that charming, huh?
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: He's totally my type! Oh, by the way, Caroline, I heard your husband's back. How's he doing after all those years away?
output.speaker: DEMI

output.text: Alright I guess. But that's okay, we're still living our best lives!
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Ha. Caroline Baker, always the optimist. Later, you're gonna help me pick out a sizzling dress. I need to capture our young hot chairman at the welcome party!
output.speaker: DEMI

output.text: You got it, girl. Good luck! Caroline hangs up then runs to catch up with Riley. He takes her hand, they exchange a warm smile, and enter the house together.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: INT. BAKER HOUSE - DAY
Riley and Caroline walk in. HEIDI(30, Caroline's sister), NICK(30, Caroline's brother-in-law), CORNELL(52, Caroline's dad), Doris are seated on the couch.
Hey, Caroline, your long-lost husband finally made it back?
output.speaker: HEIDI

output.text: Riley was just working out of town.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Good to know. I was afraid we'd see him on the news for robbing a bank and getting arrested.
output.speaker: HEIDI

output.text: That's never gonna happen, Heidi.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Alright, alright, Heidi's just messing around. Riley, are those gifts for us?
output.speaker: NICK

output.text: Yes, Nick, pick whatever you like. Riley opens the gifts he brought.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: This is it? Riley is momentarily taken aback. Heidi steps forward and starts poking at the gifts. HEIDI Looks like plastic brooches, some wine from a fake vineyard, and cheap ceramics that wouldn't even sell for ten bucks? Heidi turns to Caroline. HEIDI Aye, Caroline, you sure your man's not playing some joke on us?
output.speaker: HEIDI

output.text: EXT. AUTO PLANT - DAY
INT. BAKER HOUSE - DAY
Mike is pacing outside, holding the note in his hand, peeking inside nervously. EAMON(late 30s) approaches him.
Riley, Caroline, Doris, Cornell, Nick, and Heidi are in the living room.
Hey kid, what are you doing here? Shouldn't you be home for Christmas?
output.speaker: EAMON

output.text: Riley! What's the deal here? I try to help you get a job, and you just throw it back in my face?
output.speaker: CORNELL

output.text: Are you the man who works at the auto plant? Eamon is taken aback for a moment.
output.speaker: MIKE

output.text: Someone like you should show some respect to Bob, and not act like some smart-ass!
output.speaker: DORIS

output.text: Yeah, I am. I'm the head of the inspection department. Just doing a final check on some cars before I leave. But you, kid, you should be at home. Mike eagerly hands Eamon the note.
output.speaker: EAMON

output.text: Riley, I'm warning you! If you care more about your so called dignity than getting a job, then you really are the biggest fool in the world! Mike bursts in, waving a toy, thrilled.
output.speaker: HEIDI

output.text: My uncle gave me this note. He said I can pick out a car and get the toy that comes with it! Eamon sighs and takes the note, ready to dismiss it.
output.speaker: MIKE

output.text: Nick! Heidi! Look!
output.speaker: MIKE

output.text: Oh boy, another one of those silly pranks. I bet this is just as useless... Eamon glances at the note, and suddenly, his expression changes. EAMON Oh my God... Is this real? This has the Wharton Group Chairman's seal on it?
output.speaker: EAMON

output.text: Everyone looks at him, surprised.
Mister, can I go in and pick a car now? Eamon, still in shock, reexamines the note, then looks at Mike in disbelief.
output.speaker: MIKE

output.text: Did you really get the same toy?
output.speaker: HEIDI

output.text: Uh... yes. Yes, of course. Please, follow me... sir .
output.speaker: EAMON

output.text: And a car! Mr. Eamon drove it over for me!
output.speaker: MIKE

output.text: A- a car? Riley smiles as everyone heads outside, where Eamon is just parking the car at the front door. He steps out of the car.
output.speaker: HEIDI

output.text: Is this spot okay, little buddy?
output.speaker: EAMON

output.text: Perfect! Thanks, mister! Eamon smiles, waves, then leaves on foot. Everyone else just stares at the luxury car in shock and exchange stunned glances.
output.speaker: MIKE

output.text: INT. BECK HOUSE - DAY
Everyone is gathered inside, still processing what just happened. Heidi mutters to herself.
That...that's a limited edition Phantom. It's at least in the eight-figure range. Am I dreaming?
output.speaker: HEIDI

output.text: This is real, right? I can't believe Riley actually managed to get a car like this! Doris and Caroline both turn to Riley, shocked. Riley simply smiles.
output.speaker: NICK

output.text: This is ridiculous! Mike, how did you get that car? Mike waves the note with excitement.
output.speaker: DORIS

output.text: I just gave Mr. Eamon this note, like this, and he took me to see the cars! He even said the seal on it was really important!
output.speaker: MIKE

output.text: Seal? What seal?
output.speaker: NICK

output.text: Nick takes the note and examines it closely. After a moment, a realization hits him.
I get it now! I know how Mike got that car, and I know exactly what kind of dirty trick Riley was pulling!
output.speaker: NICK

output.text: What are you talking about?
output.speaker: HEIDI

output.text: He's a damn fraud, that's what he is!
output.speaker: NICK

output.text: Nick, what are you saying? If you know something, just tell us!
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: This note got the toy because of the seal on it! You forged the Wharton Group's executive seal, didn't you? You tricked that guy into giving Mike the car!
output.speaker: NICK

output.text: So that's it! You can just pull out a fake seal like that. Clearly, you've done this before! You're a con artist!
output.speaker: HEIDI

output.text: God, you're nothing but trash!
output.speaker: DORIS

output.text: Wait! Wait! Maybe this is just a huge misunderstanding! Riley stands there, stunned.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: INT. BAKER HOUSE – DAY
INT. POLICE STATION – DAY
Doris and the others watch Farra leave in confusion.
Riley sits coldly at an interrogation table as Whelan throws a document in front of him.
Ms. Fara Ewing seemed really upset. What do we do?
output.speaker: DORIS

output.text: Nick told me to make sure you got what's coming to you, Riley. We're practically family, so I gotta ask. How could you steal such expensive items from Ms. Farra Ewing?
output.speaker: WHELAN

output.text: It's all because Riley stole from her! Now she hates us too!
output.speaker: HEIDI

output.text: I didn't steal anything. And you're gonna regret keeping me here without knowing the facts.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Damn that Riley! He deserves a bullet in his head! My brother Whelan works at the police station, and I've already told him to teach that son of a bitch a lesson!
output.speaker: NICK

output.text: You think I respect you because I'm being civil? You're a worthless piece of trash. Even if I beat you to death, nothing would come of it. Whelan jabs his finger at the document. WHELAN Sign this confession! If you cooperate, I might let you go home for Christmas! Riley scoffs.
output.speaker: WHELAN

output.text: Enough!
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: And if I refuse?
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Everyone turns to Caroline, who looks disappointed and tired. She backs away, shaking her head.
You shouldn't have said those things. I am Riley's wife, and I have nothing to do with Andrew!
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Caroline! We're doing this for your future. Why are you still defending that worthless husband of yours? When will you grow up? Andrew steps in trying to wrap his arm around Caroline.
output.speaker: DORIS

output.text: Yeah, Caroline, I'm a thousand times better than that loser. Why won't you accept that? Caroline recoils from Andrew's touch, shocked.
output.speaker: ANDREW

output.text: This Christmas lunch is over. I'm going to find Riley.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Damn it! Caroline heads for the door. Doris and the others frown in disapproval as they watch her leave.
output.speaker: ANDREW

output.text: INT. POLICE STATION – DAY

You piece of shit, are you really going to make me get violent? Whelan pulls out a gun, closing in on Riley. WHELAN It's Christmas, so don't blame me for not showing family loyalty! I could kill you right here and no one would give a shit.
output.speaker: WHELAN

output.text: Whelan, I'll give you one last chance because we're family. Put the gun down, or you won't like the consequences.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Are you're threatening me?
output.speaker: WHELAN

output.text: He aims the gun at Riley's head. A POLICEMAN rushes in.
Whelan! We’ve got a problem! Outside.... Whelan kicks the policeman, angry.
output.speaker: POLICEMAN

output.text: What's the matter with you? I'm here, why are you scared shitless?
output.speaker: WHELAN

output.text: This is serious.
output.speaker: POLICEMAN

output.text: Well, spit it out then. What the hell is it?
output.speaker: WHELAN

output.text: Ms. Farra Ewing, the manager of Ravenham Motors, she's here!
output.speaker: POLICEMAN

output.text: What? Quick, get ready to give her a warm welcome! Whelan rushes to greet her, but Farra enters with her bodyguards, looking furious.
output.speaker: WHELAN

output.text: Ms. Ewing! What brings you here on this fine holiday? Farra glances at Riley, then turns to Whelan coldly.
output.speaker: WHELAN

output.text: What are you doing?
output.speaker: FARRA

output.text: This piece of trash stole the Christmas gifts you prepared for the chairman! Good thing I caught him! I was just about to get it out of him! He's been denying it, but don't worry! I'm about to teach him a lesson! Riley chuckles, and Farra struggles to contain her anger. Whelan, obviously not reading the room, continues with his cocky and fawning tone. WHELAN Don't worry! He got the balls to steal from you, so I'll make sure he pays!
output.speaker: WHELAN

output.text: INT. POLICE STATION - DAY
Riley smirks, looking directly at Whelan.
Whelan, dude, I applaud your effort, but you better start thinking about how you're gonna beg for mercy!
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Still running your mouth, I can end you right here, cocksucker!
output.speaker: WHELAN

output.text: He turns to Farra with a fake smile.
Ms. Ewing, I'm about to teach him a lesson. It's about to get messy. Maybe you should wait outside so you don't have to see it. Farra slaps Whelan hard across the face.
output.speaker: WHELAN

output.text: You idiot!
output.speaker: FARRA

output.text: Whelan holds his face, stunned.
Ma'am, what's that for?
output.speaker: WHELAN

output.text: You wanna know why? You don't even respect the chairman of the Wharton Group! You're lucky I didn't put a bullet in your head right now!
output.speaker: FARRA

output.text: The ch...
Him? He's the chairman? Riley stands tall, glaring at Whelan.
I warned you you were gonna regret this. Farra steps closer to Riley, bowing.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Sir, I'm so sorry! I should've gotten here sooner. I'll make sure this is handled properly.
output.speaker: FARRA

output.text: It's good you were late. Otherwise I wouldn't have the chance to watch this idiot make a fool of himself. Whelan, now panicked, falls to his knees. Two of Riley's men are closing in on him.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Riley—no, Mr. Diaz— Sir! Please forgive me! I was too stupid to recognize who you are! Please, for the sake of family, have mercy!
output.speaker: WHELAN

output.text: Now you want to talk about family? You were going to shoot me. Kindly inform his family he's going away for a while. On a... business trip.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Yes, sir.
output.speaker: FARRA

output.text: Wait! Where am I going?
output.speaker: WHELAN

output.text: The two men, putting on leather gloves, one takes out a black duct tape, corner Whelan, his scream of pain echoes the room as Riley walks out without another glance.
EXT. POLICE STATION - DAY
Riley heads towards the exit and bumps into CODY BROWN(45).
Riley? Riley Diaz? Riley pauses, puzzled, then slowly recognizes him.
output.speaker: CODY

output.text: Cody? You're the manager at Wharton Group. What brings you to the police station? Cody bows slightly and respectfully
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Ravenham Auto applied for a ten- million-dollar project. I'm here to assess it. Then I heard you were arrested, so I rushed over. Who had the audacity to disrespect you?
output.speaker: CODY

output.text: Just a bunch of idiots! Anyway, keep an eye on the auto plant for embezzlement. I have a feeling some fools are up to no good.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Absolutely, sir! In fact, I've noticed some discrepancies in the accounts, which is why I came to investigate in person. Something tells me Bob, the deputy director, is moving funds out of the company.
output.speaker: CODY

output.text: Deputy director, Bob? Cody, let's have a Christmas party at the auto plant this afternoon, and bring Bob. I'm gonna make sure those fools learn their lesson. Cody bows with humility.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: I'll take care of it.
output.speaker: CODY

output.text: As Cody leaves, Caroline approaches the police station, glancing across the street.
Hey! Caroline! Caroline turns, seeing Demi running toward her. She hesitates, then forces a smile. Riley, exiting the station, notices Caroline.
output.speaker: DEMI

output.text: Caroline? She skipped Christmas lunch to come looking for me? She really does care! God, she's adorable.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: He walks towards her
Demi, what are you doing here? I thought you're picking out your sizzling hot dress. Riley, not far away, waves cheerfully.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Caroline! Sweetheart! Demi grabs Caroline's hand, concerned.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: I heard your husband stole something meant for the Wharton Group chairman. I can't believe this is happening! Caroline, are you okay?
output.speaker: DEMI

output.text: EXT. STREET OUTSIDE POLICE STATION - DAY
Riley and I had a fight, and now I regret it. I can't believe he'd actually steal something. There must be some misunderstanding!
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Honey, you're always so kind, always thinking of others, but I hate to see you getting fooled. Maybe your husband isn't as honest as you think.
output.speaker: DEMI

output.text: No, Demi. You don't know him like I do. He's really a good man! Demi sighs, and pats Caroline on the shoulder.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Caroline, I just want you to know, you deserve better. Look at the chairman of Wharton Group. He brought his wife such amazing gifts. She must be over the moon! Caroline looks down, disheartened. Something occurs to Demi as her face lights up. DEMI Oh, right! What about Andrew, our chief engineer at the auto plant? He's been after you for a while. You should let him in and ditch your useless husband! Riley crosses the street, nearly getting hit by a car. He frowns. The car squeaks to a stop. BOWEN AMOS (27) rolls down
output.speaker: DEMI

output.text: his window, furious.
What the hell? You tryna get killed? (suddenly recognizes Riley) Oh, well, if it isn't my old pal Riley! Riley scowls, annoyed.
output.speaker: BOWEN

output.text: Bowen? You nearly ran me over and have the nerve to yell at me? You should thank God I'm not hurt, or you'd be the one who gets killed!
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Dammit, Riley! Sure, you got all those A's in high school, but out here, that doesn't mean squat. One call from me, and you won't know what hit you! Riley scoffs.
output.speaker: BOWEN

output.text: You not only refuse to apologize, but now you're acting all tough?
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Yeah, so what? I got money and power, I've got every right to be tough! Look at you, poor and pathetic. What good did all those grades do you? Still begging for my spare change? Buddy, do you even know who I am? I'm the head mechanic at Raveham Auto. I've got dozens of guys under me! You don't keep your mouth shut, and I'll have them beat you so bad you won't even see straight!
output.speaker: BOWEN

output.text: EXT. POLICE STATION STREET - DAY
Riley stands on the sidewalk, watching as Bowen sneers at him from inside his car.
From a small-time thug to a big- time one. Impressive, Bowen. Should I applaud?
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Fuck you, bitch! You're asking for it! Borwin reaches for the door handle to get out, but his phone rings. He pauses to answer it. BOWEN What? A Christmas party at the factory this afternoon? Everyone's going? Even Andrew? Riley crosses his arms, watching Bowen with amusement as he talks on the phone. BOWEN Perfect! I was just gonna deliver Andrew's Christmas gift. I'm hoping he'll give me the contract for the auto repair on the new project.
output.speaker: BOWEN

output.text: They're applying for ten million from Wharton Group! Bowen hangs up and looks at Riley with contempt.
You're lucky I got bigger fish to fry.
output.speaker: BOWEN

output.text: I'm off to the Christmas party to meet the man who got me into the factory, Andrew! But next time I see you, I'll make sure you beg for mercy! Bowen drives off, leaving Riley standing there, unimpressed.
output.speaker: BOWEN

output.text: So working at Ravenham Auto makes you this cocky? Bowen, Andrew...
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: The factory's really full of parasites. He smiles to himself and continues walking, waving to Caroline.
Caroline! Across the street, Demi stands face-to-face with Caroline.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Caroline, trust me. If you get together with Andrew, your life will be a million times better.
output.speaker: DEMI

output.text: Demi, Doris has already told me this a hundred times today. Please, don't start.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: But Caroline, I'm only thinking of you. Imagine how bad you'll feel when I become the boss's wife, and you're still stuck with that loser. Caroline breaks out in laughter.
output.speaker: DEMI

output.text: Alright, alright. I know your boss is the best! But remember, Demi, the guy is married.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Who cares? Even if he is, he's a million times better than your broke, no-good, thieving husband. By the way, did you hear? The factory's hosting a Christmas party this afternoon. Maybe the boss will show up. You should meet him. He's rich, handsome... he's got the whole package!
output.speaker: DEMI

output.text: Riley approaches them, still smiling.
EXT. STREET OUTSIDE POLICE STATION - DAY
Riley continues down the street when a young man bumps into him, snatching his wallet. Riley immediately grabs his arm.
You've got guts stealing from me.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: What are you talking about? Let me go!
output.speaker: YOUNG MAN

output.text: Hand it over.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: The young man jerks his arm free and tries to run, but Riley quickly catches him, snatching the wallet back. The young man escapes, stumbling down the street.
Run all you want. The police station's right ahead. Have fun explaining yourself. Riley checks his wallet, then puts it back in his pocket, continuing down the street.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Alright, Demi. Even if the boss doesn't show up at the party, I'll still see him at the welcome dinner tonight.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: You're right! I'm just so hyped. I need to go pick out a dress! See you later! Demi hurries off as Riley strides over to Caroline, who looks surprised. He takes her hand, grinning.
output.speaker: DEMI

output.text: Babe! I knew you were worried about me.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: Riley? You're out? (touches his arm, concerned) Are you hurt?
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: No worries. Farra came by and cleared everything up with the cops. I'm free as a bird!
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: That's good. Thank God Farra's too busy with the Christmas party to deal with you. I don't want to fight on Christmas day. But I'm not gonna be happy if this happens again.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: No problem, There won't be a next time.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: He gently kisses her. She smiles lovingly at him.
I just heard the factory is having a Christmas party this afternoon. Come with me.
output.speaker: CAROLINE

output.text: Sounds good.
output.speaker: RILEY

output.text: I'll grab us a cab.
