output.text: Out west?
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Mm-hmm. Just a remote place. When my dad was young, he was a reckless playboy. Grandpa and Grandma exiled him to the wild to learn some discipline. That’s where he met my mom. She was a schoolteacher. They fell in love, moved in together, and she got pregnant. He used her pregnancy as an excuse to return home, but… he was still a womanizer. He quickly grew tired of her...
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Arthur looks thoughtful.
Why are you suddenly asking me all this?
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Her connection to the Reid family isn’t clear yet. Better not upset her. Arthur forces a smile.
Oh, I just realized... We’ve been married for a while, but I’ve never met your mom.
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Katherine is taken aback.
Or... are you planning to never let me meet your family?
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: I... honestly never thought about it.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Arthur stands up, emotional.
Katherine, you’re my wife. Don’t tell me you’re not going to give me proper introduction to your family.
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Katherine sets down the bowl and takes Arthur’s hand to soothe him.
Easter is coming up. Let’s visit her grave. I’ll formally introduce her to her son-in-law.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Then it’s settled! Arthur sits back down, still holding Katherine’s hand, looking deeply into her eyes.
Babe... that day at the marriage office. If it hadn’t been me standing there, would you have just married whoever?
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Yes.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Arthur blinks, stunned—not just surprised, but clearly jealous and hurt.
39-1 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM – NIGHT
I didn’t go there to choose a husband. I was looking for a partner. But if it hadn’t been you, we would’ve never seen each other again.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Arthur starts grinning secretly.
When I first saw you, I thought, How can a human be this attractive?
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Arthur is stunned for a second.
Hu... human? Babe, actually I—
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Katherine nods with a knowing smile.
Arthur melts instantly at her smile. He reaches out, gently touching her face and leaning in close to her ear.
So my wife only loves me for my appearance, huh?
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Katherine blinks, then casually slips her hand toward ARTHUS's waist and starts tickling him. But Arthur quickly turns the tables and starts tickling her back. Katherine bursts into uncontrollable laughter.
Is it true? Huh? Is it?
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Yes! I love your appearance! And when you're old and wrinkly, I’ll go find myself another good-looking man...
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Arthur grabs her hands, pins them above her head, and playfully pushes her down onto the couch.
Not a chance! Babe, I am your good- looking man!
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Katherine looks into his soft, affectionate eyes and her heart melts.
Then what about you? If I hadn’t dragged you to get married that day... would you have just left with someone else?
Never. The moment I saw you, I knew— I was born to be with you.
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Katherine nods slightly, trying to wriggle her hands free.
Okay, I get it... now let me go.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: You don’t get it!
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: He frees one hand, cups the back of her head, and kisses her deeply.
Katherine... I'm not the human you think I am. I am your one true Alpha King!
output.speaker: ARTHUR (V.O.)

scenes.location: A INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM
B INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM
C INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM

output.text: 40-1 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM – DAY
40-2 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM – DAY
40-3 INT. LEXON MANSION – DAY

Katherine, aroused and emboldened, flips Arthur beneath her, meeting his fierce kiss with equal passion. Arthur, unwilling to yield, slides his hand down her shoulder, slipping off her coat as he rolls her back beneath him. Their bodies entwine in a fevered embrace — breathless, unrelenting, lost in the rhythm of desire.

Katherine lies asleep on the couch, wrapped in a blanket, one bare shoulder exposed. Arthur brings breakfast, setting the tray down with a soft clink. Katherine stirs awake, her eyes flashing red for a brief moment before returning to normal.
Cole holds the phone, speaking cautiously with forced warmth.
Why do I feel... the wolf inside me growing stronger? My human husband shouldn’t be able to...
output.speaker: KATHERINE (V.O.)

output.text: Katherine, it’s been so long since we’ve seen each other. After all, we’re still father and daughter...
output.speaker: COLE

output.text: Arthur reappears with another plate of food.
40-3A INT. LEXON MANSION – DAY
Morning, babe! Breakfast is ready!
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Wait—don’t hang up! I know I wronged you. I was fooled by Joanna, but now we’re divorcing. We need to reclaim the territories under her control—how to handle it is up to you as the Alpha. And also...
output.speaker: COLE

output.text: Katherine notices Arthur, slowly sitting up as she realizes she’s half-dressed on the couch.
40-3B INT. LEXON MANSION – DAY
I never should’ve let him have his way last night. How am I supposed to look at this couch—no, this entire living room—the same way again?!
output.speaker: KATHERINE (V.O.)

output.text: The remaining 5% of the scattered territories have been bought up by a single buyer. They’re offering to sell them back—at a high price. You need to come back so that we can talk more about this.
She grabs a nearby pillow and hurls it at him. Arthur catches it, bewildered.
What’s wrong, babe? Was last night... not good enough for you?
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Katherine glares at him, even more irritated.
You—!
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Arthur quickly raises his hands, bracing for another pillow attack. Suddenly, Katherine’s phone rings. She answers.
What do you want?
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: 40-2A INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM – DAY
output.location: A INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM

output.text: Spare me the act. I’m hanging up.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: 40-2B INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM – DAY
output.location: B INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM

output.text: Katherine frowns. Arthur looks equally confused.
...Go on.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: 40-2C INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM – DAY
output.location: C INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM

output.text: Fine. I’ll be there soon.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: She hangs up. Katherine gets up, still wrapped in the blanket. Arthur immediately steps forward.
Where are you going?
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Joanna must be getting impatient if she’s using Cole to bait me with that “father-daughter b.s.” Let’s see what else they’ve got.
Let me come with you.
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: No. Your presence would only scare them into hiding. I need you to handle something else for me.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Understood. You take the outside world, and I’ll hold down the fort.
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: 41-1 INT. LEXON MANSION, DINING ROOM – DAY
Katherine enters. She sees Cole and Lucas chatting enthusiastically. Lucas is dressed like a businessman. Both of them notice her. Cole stands up.
Katherine, this is Mr. Reid, the one I mentioned whose looking to sell some land.
output.speaker: COLE

output.text: Lucas smiles shrewdly and steps forward, extending his hand.
Pleasure to meet you, Alpha.
output.speaker: LUCAS

output.text: Katherine gives his hand a cold glance, unmoved. Lucas freezes awkwardly, looks at Cole. Cole chuckles nervously and gestures to the seats.
Well. Shall we sit?
output.speaker: COLE

output.text: Lucas returns to his seat, crossing his legs. Katherine places her bag down, subtly adjusting its position, then sits.
Mr. Reid? So you currently hold 5% of the LEXON lands?
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: That’s right!
output.speaker: LUCAS

output.text: With 5%, Mr. Reid, you'd qualify to be a council member. May I ask... how you acquired such substantial holdings?
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Lucas shifts uncomfortably, lowers his leg.
That’s... a bit nosy, don’t you think? If you’re not buying, someone else will!
output.speaker: LUCAS

output.text: He rises, pretending to storm off. Cole quickly pulls him back down.
Let’s eat first, Mr. Reid. We can talk later.
output.speaker: COLE

output.text: He gestures to the wineglass in front of Katherine.
Katherine, Mr. Reid brought some fine wine. Give it a try. KAtherine eyes the strong drink.
output.speaker: COLE

output.text: Heard our new Alpha is bold and sharp. As the saying goes- a deal is a deal. We can still be friends.
output.speaker: LUCAS

output.text: He raises his glass, toasts her, and downs it.
Since Mr. Reid’s so sincere, I’d be rude not to drink.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: She smiles faintly, lifts her glass, and drinks. Lucas claps joyfully.
Brilliant! The Alpha doesn’t disappoint!
output.speaker: LUCAS

output.text: Katherine dabs her mouth with the napkin and sets it down.
So, how much are you asking for your 5% territory?
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Lucas smirks, silent. Suddenly, Katherine’s vision spins. Her eyes blur. She shuts them, pinches her thigh hard.
That territory... Depends if you live long enough to claim it.
output.speaker: LUCAS

output.text: 42-1 INT. LEXON MANSION, DINING ROOM – DAY
42-2 INT. KATHERINE’S BEDROOM – DAY
Katherine is barely holding herself up.
Katherine lies unconscious, face pale. JOANNA stands nearby, arms crossed, sneering.
You poisoned me?!
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: If I'd known Vermora could tame you this easy, I wouldn't have wasted all the efforts!
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Cole rises.
She laughs scornfully.
Katherine, don’t blame me. You’ve never listened.
output.speaker: COLE

output.text: Who’d think the mighty Alpha still craved... fatherly love? JOANNA(CONT’D) I’ve won, Katherine. Lexon is mine!
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Katherine clutches her head, shaking it, trying to stay conscious.
Cole enters, nervous, eyes darting to Katherine.
My old man spoiled you, made you the Alpha.
output.speaker: COLE

output.text: Joanna—you promised me. She’s just paralyzed, not dead, right?
output.speaker: COLE

output.text: Her face goes pale.
Does it matter anymore?
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: I’m his son—your father! I should’ve been Alpha!
output.speaker: COLE

output.text: She’s still my blood, the only legitimate Lexon heir!
output.speaker: COLE

output.text: She stumbles up, turns to flee—but collapses.
Joanna pokes his chest.
Spare me the “fatherly concern”! You were first to agree to drug her.
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: I only wanted to secure our control—not kill her!
output.speaker: COLE

output.text: Not my problem. You lured her here. You’re the last person she saw.
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: What?
output.speaker: COLE

output.text: Lexon isn’t ours, darling. It’s mine. You don’t even own a square foot.
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Cole stumbles back in disbelief.
Joanna, you—
output.speaker: COLE

output.text: Joanna bursts out laughing and storms off.
43-1 INT. LEXON MANSION, HALLWAY – DAY
43-2 INT. KATHERINE’S BEDROOM – NIGHT
43-3 INT. LEXON MANSION, DINING ROOM – DAY
Joanna struts confidently, on the phone.
The room is dark. Katherine stirs awake, groaning in pain. Suddenly, she notices a man beside her. She grabs a pillow and hurls it at him.
Katherine discreetly spits the liquor into her napkin, feigning a casual wipe.
Publicly announce that Katherine's health has failed. Out of respect, I'll shoulder her burdens and take control of all Lexon family affairs.
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Who are you?! What are you doing in my bed?!
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Arthur bolts up, catches the pillow, gently covers her mouth.
Babe. It’s me. Shh... There are guards outside.
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Katherine recognizes him.
Arthur?! Scare me like that again and you're banned from the bedroom!
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Arthur kneels, dramatically bowing on the bed.
My Queen! You’ve been unconscious for three days! I thought I lost you!
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Three days?!
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: 43-2A INT. KATHERINE’S BEDROOM – NIGHT
Didn’t I spit most of it out? Just that tiny bit left in my mouth was enough to knock me out for three days?
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Arthur rolls a table over with food.

That little bit was enough to activate all the remaining toxins in your system. I’ve been here every day since, watching over you, giving you the antidote. And now... Good news: Vermora is completely purged!
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Really? A blessing in disguise!
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: He holds her hand.
Your inner wolf is fully awaken now. No one will ever dare use that against you again.
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: She touches his face.
Wolf or not—I have you. That’s what matters.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Arthur gazes at her.
I’ll make you a true wolf. A perfect and powerful Alpha Queen.
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: How does one become a true wolf… with a human?
output.speaker: KATHERINE (V.O.)

output.text: She smiles, picks up her fork.
What’s the matter outside?
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: 44-1 INT. LEXON MANSION, LIVING ROOM – DAY
The room is packed. Joanna enters with proud.
Esteemed guests, reporters, members of Lexon — thank you for coming. Please, be seated. Reporters click away. Joanna basks in attention.
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Twenty years... I’ve rightfully claimed this seat!
output.speaker: JOANNA (V.O.)

output.text: Joanna, are your previous involvement in money laundering and the kidnapping of Alpha connected to your alleged attempt to seize power through malicious means?? JOANNA lifts her chin, arms crossed, a look of disdain on her face.
output.speaker: REPORTER A

output.text: Of course not. Katherine fabricated those accusations. If I was guilty, then why would the Bureau have cleared me of all charges so quickly?
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Was Katherine’s illness your doing?
output.speaker: REPORTER B

output.text: Joanna sighs, feigning sorrow.
Katherine has been ill since eleven years ago. She’s been actively seeking treatment recently, and here is her medical report. She distributes papers. Whispers ripple through the crowd.
Paralyzed... It’s true. She’s been sick for a while...
output.speaker: CROWD A

output.text: As the largest landholder, are you now Lexon’s new Alpha?
output.speaker: REPORTER C

output.text: Yes. I brought you all here today to reassure you.
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Katherine is fighting for her life. As her family, I grieve.
From this moment on, I, Joanna Lexon, assume full authority as the Lexon Alpha! Mixed reactions—some applaud, others reluctantly follow.
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: 45-1 INT. KATHERINE’S BEDROOM – NIGHT
45-2 EXT. REID HOUSE – DAY
45-3 INT. REID HOUSE – DAY
Frost hands Katherine a coffee. She sips it lazily.
Joanna clutches a file, scans her surroundings, hurries inside. Frost watches from above.
Lucas sits at the head, one eye bandaged. Two masked guards stand behind him. Joanna kneels, offering the folder.
Ma’am, as you instructed, we’ve created the illusion. Everyone thinks your days are numbered.
output.speaker: FROST

output.text: Lady Alpha, she’s inside. I’m sending the address.
output.speaker: FROST

output.text: Mr. Reid... here it is. The Lexon family... is mine now.
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Katherine runs her fingers along the rim of the cup, deep in thought.

Lucas lifts his chin slightly. The bodyguard behind him immediately steps forward and hands him the file. Joanna trembles uncontrollably, nervous and afraid. Lucas flips through the file, then calmly closes it and looks coldly at Joanna.
Good. Now Joanna thinks she’s won. Whoever’s behind her should act soon.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Is Katherine... dead?
output.speaker: LUCAS

output.text: You think she’ll reach out to them?
output.speaker: FROST

output.text: Katherine nods.
Time to bait the serpent. Frost, watch her. Every call, every move.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Understood.
output.speaker: FROST

output.text: Frost bolts for the window.
Wait—that’s a window—
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Katherine is stunned. She lets out a sigh and leans back against the headboard.
These people… Who are they?
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: 46-1 INT. REID HOUSE – DAY
Joanna cautiously approaches Lucas.
Almost there! She’s in a deep coma now. I’ve got my people watching over her.
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: You sure she won’t wake up?
output.speaker: LUCAS

output.text: I’m sure! Mr. Reid, I’ve done everything. Can I have the antidote now?
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: You will have it when the Lexon family is completely destroyed.
output.speaker: LUCAS

output.text: Joanna exhales and nods. Lucas pulls out a small pill.
This pill will keep your Vermora from flaring up for a whole year.
output.speaker: LUCAS

output.text: Joanna nods eagerly. Lucas disdainfully tosses the pill on the ground. Joanna crawls forward quickly, picking it up with both hands.
Thank you, Mr. Reid! Thank you!
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Who are you? This is Reid territory! No entry!
output.speaker: MASKED BODYGUARD (O.S.)

output.text: Get lost.
output.speaker: KATHERINE (O.S.)

output.text: Lucas hears noises outside. His expression freezes. Joanna turns pale, looking back— Katherine enters, dressed all in black, radiating power. Several SHADOW GUARDS follow her. Joanna collapses to the floor, eyes wide with disbelief.
Katherine?! That can’t be!
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Katherine raises an eyebrow and smiles lightly.
Ms. Hardy, what a coincidence.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: 47-1 INT. REID MANSION – DAY
Joanna looks back at Lucas, terrified; her voice trembling and hoarse.
Mr. Reid, this can’t be. I’ve poisoned her! You saw her drink the wine and fall unconscious!
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Lucas slowly stands and approaches JOANNA. He slaps her hard. Katherine looks at Lucas, fearless and determined.
It’s you?! We meet again. This time, you’re nothing like before.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Katherine walks in and sees Lucas dressed like a businessman.
Lucas sizes her up, then coldly approaches.
You weren’t dead nor poisoned. You kept up that whole act just to meet me here
output.speaker: LUCAS

output.text: Joanna’s just a pawn. Of course I want to meet the player?
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Lucas smirks coldly, ominous.
You are a Reid. Lexon and Reid have no feud. What are you after?
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Lucas laughs loudly.
So merciless, and so precise. Quite unlike your mother, I must say.
output.speaker: LUCAS

output.text: Katherine is shocked.
You know my mother?
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: You’ll find out soon enough. We’ll meet again.
output.speaker: LUCAS

output.text: Lucas smirks, then gestures. Masked Bodyguards swarm forward. Shadow Guards defend Katherine. A fierce fight breaks out. Joanna screams hysterically.
Mr. Reid! Mr. Reid! You have to believe me— Among the crowd, Katherine looks up to Lucas standing above.
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Lucas overlooks the battlefield. Katherine tries to pursue but is blocked. Frost blocks a punch from a Masked Bodyguard and pushes him away. Katherine looks up again. Lucas smirks mockingly and walks away.
48-1 INT. REID MANSION - DAY
The battle dies down quickly. Lucas’s bodyguards and Joanna lie defeated on the ground.
Ma'am, My fault. They got away through the underground tunnel.
output.speaker: FROST

output.text: Katherine stares at the place where Lucas vanished.
It’s not your fault. They were prepared. This was just a temporary base for them.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Yes, ma’am. what about...her?
output.speaker: FROST

output.text: Frost points at Joanna. She’s collapsed on the floor, dazed and disoriented.
It’s over... It’s all over...
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Looks like they’ve abandoned you.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Joanna lifts her head and glares at Katherine, trembling as she gets to her feet.
Even if I'm abandoned, you'll never lay hands on me! You've got no proof!
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Of course I do.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Katherine takes a pinhole camera out of her bag.
I’ve had this camera on me since I entered the mansion. Everything you and Cole did to me. It’s all recorded. Joanna, this time, you’re not getting away.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Joanna stumbles backward in shock.
You... You were planning this since the moment I answered your call?!
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: That’s right. I respected your ambition, but in the end, you’re just someone’s lapdog.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: You think I wanted this? It was
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Lucas Reid!
I was just an orphan—until Lucas took me in. He used Vermora to turn me into his puppet!
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: So all these years...
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: It was Lucas’s plan? Even marrying my father?
Why else? You think I’d stoop for your pathetic father? Lucas’s real plan was always to wipe out the entire Lexon bloodline! Hahahahahahaha!
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Katherine grabs Joanna by the throat, trembling in disbelief.
So it was you who killed my mother?! Why? Why would you do that?!
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Joanna clutches her throat, gasping for air, her face turning red.
Your mother was killed… by Cole Lexon!
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: 49-1 INT. REID MANSION – DAY
49-2 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT – NIGHT
Katherine is in complete shock. Her grip loosens. Joanna catches her breath and continues.
Katherine stares blankly out the window. Arthur walks over and wraps his arms around her.
He forced your mother to sign divorce papers while she was giving birth.
Frost said you met someone from the Reid family? Katherine nods slowly, curling up in his embrace. Arthur pulls out a small bugging device from his coat pocket.
She died on the delivery table, furious and heartbroken! Katherine reels from the revelation. Joanna seizes the moment and breaks free, collapsing on the ground with a mocking laugh.
We found this bug in your office. It's from the Reid family—a bloodline of poisoners. Once feared, now fading with the modern world’s rejection of toxins.
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: You thought Cole was just some weak fool, but he’s too stupid to be harmless!
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: The one behind Joanna... is Lucas Reid. Alpha of the Reid family.
Katherine turns away, overcome with grief.

Here’s something else I uncovered: Lucas’s beloved daughter, Leah Reid, has always been indifferent to the family’s dirty business. She chose to escape to the countryside to teach children, and eventually broke away from the family for the sake of a man.
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Lock her up.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: She was my mother. She changed her name to Leah Hedrin. Lucas Reid... is my grandfather. Arthur exhales, holding Katherine tighter, sympathy on his face.
Frost and the shadow guards seize Joanna. As they drag her away, she screams after Katherine, her voice shrill and taunting.

Lucas Reid... Call him ruthless, yet he dotes on his daughter like she’s his whole world. Call him loving, yet he doesn’t even spare his own granddaughter. What a stubborn, twisted old man! Katherine chuckles through her pain, then looks him in the eyes.
Katherine! Your mother wasn’t a Hedrin. She was a Reid! A REID!
output.speaker: JOANNA

output.text: Grandpa used to say I’m bold and ruthless when I need to be—a born Alpha. That’s something the Lexons don’t have. No clue who I inherited it from, until I met Lucas.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Katherine closes her eyes. A single tear escapes. She keeps walking forward, resolute.
You’re nothing like him. This is his fault, not you.
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Katherine smiles faintly but her eyes well with tears.
I just feel sorry for my mother.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: She was under Lucas’s control in her youth and died heartbroken because of a scumbag. Yet, as her own daughter, I never really knew who she was. Arthur gently takes her hand.
I'm sure she was truly happy when she chose your father; unfortunately, she made the wrong choice.
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Katherine studies his face carefully.
Then what about me? Did I make a right choice?
50-1 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT LIVING ROOM – NIGHT
Arthur immediately raises his hand, swearing.
Babe! I swear to you! Going back three generations in my family, there’s absolutely no history of scumbags!
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Katherine is surprised, watching as ARTHUR counts on his fingers.
My dad, my grandpa, my great- grandpa... all loyal and loving! We’ve got good genes!
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: You’re pledging loyalty now? That’s kinda suspicious.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Honestly, I’m... I’m just worried you’re mad at your jerk dad and taking it out on me.
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Katherine can’t help but smile, watching Arthur pound his chest confidently.
I’m legit!
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: So far, so good.
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: I’ll show with every action that your taste in men is just as spot- on as your business sense.
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Katherine is touched. Arthur glances sideways, then leans in close to Katherine, getting all sweet.
But... on a serious note, babe, when are we gonna make up for our honeymoon?
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Hmm... maybe you find a place?
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Arthur grabs Katherine’s hand excitedly.
Let’s go skiing!
output.speaker: ARTHUR

output.text: Skiing?
output.speaker: KATHERINE

output.text: Arthur looks up, starts imagining, moving his hands like drawing.
